name: The New Plague
label: Quest
description: The New Plague: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!
I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
